These posts were originally published between 2010 and 2017 on **Build and Crash** (*buildandcrash.blogspot.com*), covering open-source flight controllers (OpenPilot, Tau Labs, Sparky, Freedom), embedded hardware, CNC machining, and early EEG/EMG experiments. They are preserved here as a historical archive, separate from newer technical and research posts. You can also browse additional photos and clips from that era in the [Maker & Hardware Gallery](gallery.qmd).
